sentences.text: Hello listeners wherever you are, and once again I Wish You Were Here with my two spectacular guests Prince Fong, owner of Shiny Diamond Lighting, and the company’s chief designer and neon artist Rick
Lai. My pleasure Julia to be here.
Hello everyone. Now Chris, your company has not only been a sparkling success, but you have won many prestigious awards.
Which award means the most to you though?
Well, it has to be the one we were awarded last year.
The 2021 Neon Award.
That’s Neon, right.
N -E -O -N.
as in the gas we use for lights?
Correct. It’s an award given to companies who make neon lights.
Winning the 2021 Neon Award is something we are very, very proud of.
Now let’s have a look at some of the products you have brought in.
Rick, I love these designs, especially the UFO.
It’s so green.
We also make the UFO in yellow too.
Fabulous. Green and yellow are actually my favourite colours.
And we have them in different sizes.
We have 95cm by 65cm for the large size and 34 centimetres by 20 centimetres for the small.
Actually, let me just check that size for the small again.
Yeah, 34 centimetres by 20 centimetres for the small size.
The small UFO is so cute!
How much would it cost for this one?
This small UFO is only 600.
Only 600. That’s a bargain!
And this one here.
Oh listen as I Wish You Were Here so you could see this.
It’s the Hong Kong Skyline that could be used to cover a wall.
The colours are amazing!
Yes, this one is very special.
But it’s not available yet.
You will need to wait until the 7th of June.
Well, that’s going in the calendar.
The 7th of June.
by my Hong Kong neon skyline.
Oh thank you.
Thank you. Now besides the products that you design, which we’ve just looked at, you also make designs given to you by customers?
Yes, that’s right.
Through our web page, customers can send us their designs and our neon artists, like Rick here, will make those into a neon sign.
What a wonderful service!
And I noticed you do birthday cake signs.
What’s special Well, the customer can tell us the name and the age of the birthday boy or girl and we will put their name and age onto the birthday cake sign.
Isn’t that great listeners?
Would you like to receive a neon sign of a birthday cake with your name and age on it?
I know I would.
Yes, this product is very popular.
Now Chris, let’s talk about the company’s history and its beginnings.
I heard that you and Rick have known each other quite a while now.
My goodness, yes.
We’ve known each other for many years.
In 1980, when I decided I wanted to start my own company, I realized I need a training from the best, and the best back in 1980 and still today is Rick.
So, you began your company before you met Rick?
No, no. I was thinking about starting a company in 1980, but I didn’t actually found the company until the next year, in 1981.
You see, I needed to get trained first.
Rick Lye back in 1980, was the number one neon master in Asia.
I was extremely lucky that he took me on.
In 1981, once I had finished my training with Rick, I founded Shiny Diamond Lighting.
Prince had incredible artistic talent.
What can I say?
I had the best master.
You know, Rick trained me for six months.

He was a wonderful teacher, but it was six long months of learning and very hard work, I imagine a few of our listeners might be interested in becoming neon artists, especially young people who are going
to college soon.
What would you say to any listener who would like to work in the lighting industry?
Please contact us.
Actually, we really want to hire people at the moment.
We are looking for trainees, particularly young people, to become neon light makers.
It’s a very interesting job, and we are offering excellent benefits.
We will train each trainee for six months and during that six months you will be paid.
That sounds like a wonderful opportunity.
You know what, if I weren’t working here then I would love to sign up as one of your trainees!
Six months of paid training?
That’s amazing! So when would trainees start their training?
We will start the training program in September What about the future?
What can we expect in our light displays?
Is it like all those spectacular science fiction films where we will have huge 3D projections walking around?
Not yet unfortunately.
The technology to produce the kind of 3D projections we see in science fiction films does not exist currently.
Yes, science fiction films are fiction after all.
However, we can still create a kind of 3D projection using certain.
tricks. Actually, in our current products brochure we highlight a couple of futuristic 3D projection products that we sell.
And what about neon lights Prius?
Do they have a future?
Of course, people will always And you know why?
Because neon is made in the heart of stars.
That’s a fact.
Neon gas comes from the inside of stars.
When I tell my customers that fact it really blows their mind.
They are amazed that the light they see in their sign came from inside a star.
Customers also love the art and craft of neon.
Many customers have told me this is why they prefer neon signs to newer technologies like LEDs.
Oh yes, Rick’s absolutely right.
Customers do love the art and craft of neon.
Well thank you both very much for what I’m sure our listeners will agree has been a very illuminating discussion.
Tune in next week to the Wish You Were Here podcast, where my guests will be the pop band Bubblegum.
Goodbye for now!
